readerCopy.body: A new piece of information can force an old story to defend itself. When Mercury opposes the South Node, something you hear, read, or discuss may put a familiar belief or explanation directly across from the facts in front of you. You may feel the urge to return to the version you can explain most easily. Stay with the contradiction long enough to learn from it. You are allowed to know the history without letting the history write the answer.
